Alien Deathstorm.title: Alien Deathstorm
Alien Deathstorm.summary: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in Alien Deathstorm, the new sci-fi action horror FPS from Rebellion.

Blighted (video game).title: Blighted
Blighted (video game).summary: Battle your way through a psychedelic western nightmare to reclaim the memories of your people in this action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! Harness the power of the deadly, reality-altering Blight and unravel the mysteries of a twisted world.

Clockwork Revolution.title: Clockwork Revolution
Clockwork Revolution.summary: Clockwork Revolution is a time-bending steampunk first-person RPG. After stumbling across an incredible invention that allows you to travel into the past, you discover the city you call home—the vibrant steam-powered metropolis of Avalon—has been carefully crafted through the alteration of historical events. By traveling back to key moments, your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world and characters of Avalon, causing them to change and react in unprecedented ways.

Clutch (video game).title: Clutch
Clutch (video game).summary: Clutch is a cinematic, open-world, action-driving game from the team at Maverick Games - lead by former Forza Horizon Creative Director, Mike Brown, and other senior leads on the franchise.

Crazy Taxi: World Tour.title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour
Crazy Taxi: World Tour.summary:
It's time for crazy driving, crazy adventure, and crazy money! Crazy Taxi is back and going global!

In this new high-octane adventure, follow Axel as he chases down the mysterious masked villains who stole his beloved taxi. Tackle extreme missions around the world all while earning some CRAZY money!

Daba: Land of Water Scar.title: Daba: Land of Water Scar
Daba: Land of Water Scar.summary: Daba: Land of Water Scar is a new title from Dark Star. It tells the story of a humanoid clay puppet. When the world is on the verge of collapse, the puppet traces the whereabouts of the water fragments within the ancient city, and throughout their journey of defeating enemies and seeking answers, unravels the story of the world and oneself. The game features various landscapes including abandoned ruins, a magnificent ancient city, gloomy prison, vast rift valley, expansive snowfield, deadly forest, and a floating city. Non-linear levels are interconnected, distinct, and intricate.

Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3.title: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse 3
Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3.summary:
Step into a brand-new future Dragon ball universe filled with unique, original characters brought to life by Akira Toriyama, the original author of Dragon Ball. In Age 1000, journey through developed and vibrant West City. Explore the bustling city, encounter characters, and uncover exciting new stories.
Take your place in the story and experience what awaits in West City.
Guided into the ranks of the Great Saiyan Squad, you’ll fight alongside allies as events there begin to take shape.

Game of Thrones: War for Westeros.title: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
Game of Thrones: War for Westeros.summary: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or in treacherous free-for-all multiplayer. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm. Do you have the strength to seize the Iron Throne?

Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake.title: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake
Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake.summary: Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions, faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. Explore a vibrant fantasy world and lead mighty heroes in epic battles.

Humankind 2.title: Humankind II
Humankind 2.summary: Build a civilization that spans the ages in this historical turn-based strategy game. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history.

Ill (video game).title: Ill
Ill (video game).summary: Unleash your survival instincts. Step into the sinister town, face a growing horror and uncover the unsettling truth behind the town's descent into madness. Are you ready to confront your deepest fears?

Kingdom Hearts IV.title: Kingdom Hearts IV
Kingdom Hearts IV.publisher: Square Enix, The Walt Disney Company
Kingdom Hearts IV.summary: Kingdom Hearts IV follows protagonist Sora and some familiar characters as they journey through the mysterious city of Quadratum. Sora will once again journey to various worlds, where new figures cross his path and new powers awaken in this next chapter.

Kirby and the World Beyond.title: Kirby and the World Beyond
Kirby and the World Beyond.summary: Get ready to freely explore the World Beyond using Copy Abilities in Kirby and the World Beyond, the latest 3D Kirby adventure, coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2027!

Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back.title: Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back
Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back.summary: Juliet returns to a rebuilt San Romero, now transformed into “Jaredwood”, a sprawling metropolis built around the film industry. When a mysterious director traps her inside his twisted zombie movie, Juliet must fight alongside her allies, uncover the conspiracy behind the chaos, and stop a new threat posed by the Corrupted Realm zombies.

Lords of the Fallen II.title: Lords of the Fallen II
Lords of the Fallen II.summary: Lords of the Fallen 2, the highly anticipated sequel to the game released in 2023, is set to arrive in 2026. The team at Hexworks aims to create a sequel incorporating more commercial elements, particularly in visual design, to attract a broader audience of players.

Lost & Found (video game).title: Lost & Found
Lost & Found (video game).summary: LOST & FOUND is a free to play dynamic sorting game. Match forms to the right items and build your own warehouse, or compete with your friends in multiplayer mode after your shift is over.

Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra.title: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra
Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra.summary:
This narrative-driven ensemble game stars Captain America Steve Rogers, Black Panther Azzuri (T'Challa's grandfather), U.S. soldier and member of the Howling Commandos Gabriel Jones, and leader of the fledgling Wakandan Spy Network, Nanali.

All four characters will be playable at different parts of the story. According to Skydance, players can look forward to "intuitive controls and exhilarating second-to-second gameplay that captures the action and excitement of Marvel, inspired by landmark comics, television, and films, as they navigate this all-new glob-trotting adventure."

Mega Man: Dual Override.title: Mega Man: Dual Override
Mega Man: Dual Override.summary: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

Motorsport Manager 2.title: Motorsport Manager 2
Motorsport Manager 2.summary: The world of motorsport returns in the next evolution of the ultimate motorsport management sim. Compete in multiple series, master deeper strategy than ever before, and lead your team to victory on and off the track. Build your racing legacy.

My Time at Evershine.title: My Time at Evershine
My Time at Evershine.summary: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

Navinosuke: The Yo-Kai Buster.title: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
Navinosuke: The Yo-Kai Buster.summary:
A long-lost 2D pixel art RPG returns across time.
Originally completed two decades ago but never released, this hidden gem is now being faithfully rebuilt by KOHACHI STUDIO for Nintendo Switch.
Set in ancient Japan, you play as Navinosuke, a young onmyoji-in-training, meeting and battling over 150 unique yokai.
Plan your tactics using turn-based auto battles and a shikigami system, and explore a whimsical, strategy-driven Japanese fantasy world.

Neverway.title: Neverway
Neverway.summary: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

Ontos (video game).title: Ontos
Ontos (video game).summary: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

Onyx: The Dark Grip.title: Onyx: The Dark Grip
Onyx: The Dark Grip.summary: Set in an isolated town trapped in an endless winter, ONYX: The Dark Grip challenges players to survive through two deeply intertwined roles. As The Vessel, players explore a bleak, frozen world, fight for survival, manage scarce resources and confront the dangers hiding within the town and beneath its snow. But human strength can only go so far. When The Vessel cannot survive alone, players become The God, reaching directly into his world to manipulate reality, protect their host and change what happens beyond the limits of an ordinary human being. Survival depends on knowing when to act as The Vessel and when to intervene as The God.

Out of Words.title: Out of Words
Out of Words.summary: Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands — where everything you see is crafted by hand.

Pikuniku 2.title: Pikuniku 2
Pikuniku 2.summary: Absurd puzzle-exploration adventure Pikuniku 2 brings the whimsy! Wander, solve, and gossip your way through a weird and wonderful world where not everything is as happy as it seems. Protect the potato!

Resident Evil Veronica.title: Resident Evil Veronica
Resident Evil Veronica.summary: Claire Redfield returns to the forefront in this remake of the title originally released on the Dreamcast in 2000 and the following year on PlayStation 2. This new version preserves the essence of the original game while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics.

Rev. NOiR.title: Rev. Noir
Rev. NOiR.summary: Drawn together by chance, Asch and Finé set out to stop the Lightfall, a calamity that brings death to all it touches. As their journey to save the world unfolds, they uncover a fate neither expected... Defy cruel fate in the all-new RPG, Rev. NOiR.

Senua (video game).title: Senua
Senua (video game).summary: A Celtic warrior is trapped between life and death in a fractured vision of purgatory. In an action‑adventure set in the Hellblade universe, Senua fights to reach the afterlife and reunite with those she loved and lost, battling forces that threaten all she believes in.

Shironeko Project Infinity.title: Shironeko Project Infinity
Shironeko Project Infinity.summary: Shironeko New Project is a co-op action RPG based on the mobile game Shironeko Project but will have a new story with new characters.

Spine (video game).title: Spine
Spine (video game).summary: Experience Gun Fu like never before with SPINE, an immersive and highly cinematic action game set in a cyberpunk world. Explore the realistic vision of a near-future with a rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant, Spine, as they challenge a totalitarian AI regime in search of Redline’s captured brother. Participate in epic gunfights against charismatic opponents, while performing spectacular choreography with firearms!

Spyro: A Realm Beyond.title: Spyro: A Realm Beyond
Spyro: A Realm Beyond.summary: Take flight in a brand-new journey through a strange and wondrous realm. When Spyro finds himself stranded, his journey to discover a way home is interrupted by the arrival of a vicious invading force known as the Scavs.

State of Decay 3.title: State of Decay 3
State of Decay 3.summary: Unite to survive: push back the blood plague to reclaim the land's resources and carve out a life in the zombie apocalypse.

The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperi.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperi.summary: Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. Explore the rear palace and capital to gather evidence and question witnesses, then assemble what you've learned into theories and deductions to solve thrilling mysteries in this sprawling adventure game.

The Escapists 3.title: The Escapists 3
The Escapists 3.summary: Plan ridiculous prison breaks, outsmart the guards and escape your way in The Escapists 3. Craft, sneak, fight and improvise through a new 3D prison sandbox, alone or with friends. Just remember to make roll call.

The Expanse: Osiris Reborn.title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
The Expanse: Osiris Reborn.summary: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

The Lost Wild.title: The Lost Wild
The Lost Wild.summary: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

The Talos Principle 3.title: The Talos Principle III
The Talos Principle 3.summary: The Talos Principle 3 is the last chapter of the thought-provoking first-person puzzle series, taking you on a cosmic journey across more than a dozen worlds and testing your mind with all-new challenges.

The Wolf Among Us 2.title: The Wolf Among Us 2
The Wolf Among Us 2.summary: The Wolf Among Us 2 is an episodic graphic adventure game. It is a sequel to The Wolf Among Us and takes place six months following the events of the first game. Follow Bigby Wolf in a new story filled with not-so-colorful characters from famous fairy tales.

Turok: Origins.title: Turok: Origins
Turok: Origins.summary: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

Virtua Fighter Crossroads.title: Virtua Fighter Crossroads
Virtua Fighter Crossroads.summary: The newest installment in the Virtua Fighter series, releasing in 2027.

Xenoblade Genesis.title: Xenoblade Genesis
Xenoblade Genesis.summary: A new beginning for the Xenoblade series is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.
